title: Remote users cannot connect to VPN
impact: Remote support users cannot reach internal tools.
summary: Several users report that VPN connects, drops after authentication, and then internal DNS lookup fails.

evidence.text: User elvin@example.com reports VPN handshake timeout after authentication. Similar reports from user-east-104 and user-east-233.
Handshake timeout to CHIVPNGW012. Session sess-a82fa113ff dropped after tunnel negotiation.
nslookup internal-app.local returns timeout after VPN tunnel drop from 192.168.10.24.

title: Endpoint disk pressure causing application failures
impact: Finance workstation cannot complete monthly export.
summary: Application export fails when writing temporary files. Endpoint report shows low free disk.

evidence.text: Finance user says export fails on FINLAPTOP88321 and retry does not help.
Disk free space is 4 percent. Temp cache path growth is 18 GB per day.
Write failure when exporting report to C:\Users\user-fin\AppData\Local\Temp\export.tmp.

title: MFA reset request with stale privileged access
impact: Admin user is blocked after phone replacement.
summary: MFA reset request is valid, but privileged group access has stale review evidence.

evidence.text: Admin user admin.user@example.com requests MFA reset after phone replacement.
User user-admin-882 remains in Privileged-App-Admins. Last access review is 124 days old.
Manager approval is missing. Identity verification note is older than 24 hours.
